hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [antigravity plugin] LEAN ROUTING: Claude conducts; agy/Gemini executes or checks bounded work, including small tasks. Default to `--tier flash` (latest Flash High); `--tier flash-medium` is an explicit option for clearly simple work. Reserve Pro for exceptional escalation. Prefer direct wrappers over a native Claude subagent. For repository exploration use `agy-scout`; for diff verification use `agy-review`, and ingest compact digests rather than raw files/diffs. Run the smallest sufficient test/build/lint gate. One builder, one blind verifier, and at most one repair; no agent loops. Preserve user changes and require authorization for commit/push or external/destructive actions. `AGY_ALWAYS_YOLO=1` or `always_yolo=on` grants broad machine access. If a Gemini run fails, inspect both 5h and 7d quotas; either at or below 2% is depleted. Never switch models automatically: ask the user whether to kill stalled Agy workers and continue with Claude Sonnet 4.6, or keep them alive and check both windows every 10 minutes. Append newly emitted English 75/50/25/10% quota advisories. Full details are in the `antigravity` skill.
